answer: A bond of 29% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in echo, and pulse reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 32 aliases, and each one needs its own funded fable account. A farm of 1362 identities would post 3067 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
